genuine_new: Replace one fixed evidence schedule with an outcome-contingent strategy. A sensing result activates only its branch-relevant evidence tasks and hard-invariant support hyperedges. Within each active support-connected component tasks serialize; independent components may run in parallel. READY requires every observed branch to meet the deadline at the upper bound of every task-duration interval. This avoids static-union false HOLDs while preventing resource-only false READYs caused by hidden invariant coupling.
